question: Does intellect-purusha-interval knowledge exhaust karma in kala?
premises: in intellect-discrimination, when known, in pradhana-purusha interval
even so no karma-exhausted would be
inference: Interval-knowing does not exhaust; exhaustion may dawn in kala.
plain_english: In intellect-discrimination, when known, in pradhana-purusha interval — even so no karma-exhausted would be; in kala-covering that may arise.
